newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Key points of Russia-Belarus Union Treaty.
newsitem.headline: Key points of Russia-Belarus Union Treaty.

text.p: Here is an outline of the watered-down Union Treaty between Russia and Belarus signed by the Russian leader Boris Yeltsin and Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko on Wednesday.
The document, far shorter than a draft of the pact circulated two days ago, emerged as a result of last-minute negotiations both inside the Russian government and with Minsk.
